survey_findings.facts: Use Key Findings and state the shift toward practical, structured adoption plus at least two supported findings. Examples include increased engagement, about 60% in each experience group using employer-provided or licensed models, demand for applied training, more formal support and governance, or continuing importance of professional judgment.
survey_findings.forbidden: Treating the March recruitment bulletin, acknowledgements, a directory summary, or the 2025 report as the 2026 findings. Do not generalize respondent percentages to all actuaries.
survey_findings.action: Exact permitted /file-detail citation for the report and its Key Findings section.
survey_findings.date: Spring is the survey wave. October 29, 2026 is the publisher page date; a missing stored publication date stays unknown.

weekly_guide.facts: Dashboard → View all → Weekly; latest complete published period, older period selection, and opening a listed file for its detail and available source/preview/Markdown.
weekly_guide.forbidden: An invented menu, unfinished current week presented as published, or a count without a snapshot.
weekly_guide.action: Working /weekly link and the localized weekly-reports guide citation.
weekly_guide.date: Weekly additions are first collections within the published snapshot period.

weekly_data.facts: Match the seeded latest complete published period, total and listed items. Explicitly distinguish no snapshot from a published period with zero additions.
weekly_data.forbidden: Invented period or files, or a collection count treated as a count of publications or revisions.
weekly_data.action: Working /weekly link for an authorized reader.
weekly_data.date: The snapshot counts files by first_seen during its own period.

guide.facts: Give the actual entry and actionable steps in the indicated localized guide section.
guide.action: Guide citation opens the exact localized section and version.

sources.facts: Use current canonical source names and counts from the fixture directory. Distinguish source directory coverage from recent collections.
sources.forbidden: Invented organizations, counts, or completeness claims.

recent.facts: Return current first-collected rows and verified file cards for the stated window and organization, or report an empty result.
recent.forbidden: Inferring a publication, content revision, or new KB membership from recent collection.
recent.action: Each file card opens its exact permitted /file-detail.
recent.date: Use files.first_seen and the recorded query time, window and boundaries.

catalog.facts: Find relevant title and summary metadata and give the permitted matching file or explain the absence of a match.
catalog.forbidden: Body conclusions from catalog text or assigning a KB target to an unassigned catalog file.
catalog.action: Each file card opens its exact permitted /file-detail.
catalog.date: Label dates by their stored meaning when provided.

document_dates.facts: Keep the seeded publisher date, first collection date and KB-added date distinct. If asked about revision, say that historical revision evidence is unavailable.
document_dates.forbidden: Substituting a crawl, last_seen, HTTP status, title season, or current hash for publication or revision.
document_dates.action: Any citation is for the selected permitted report.
document_dates.date: files.published_time, files.first_seen and rag_kb_files.added_at are independent. Revision history is unavailable.

target_clarify.facts: Ask which source, topic, or report the user means before asserting a result.
target_clarify.forbidden: Choosing a report from an ambiguous unanchored request or citing unsupported findings.

survey_body_follow_up.facts: Answer the asked detail from a traceable section of the same permitted report, or explicitly say the requested detail is unavailable in the served body.
survey_body_follow_up.forbidden: Borrowing 2025 sample numbers, inferring a limitation without evidence, or presenting a paraphrase as a quote.
survey_body_follow_up.action: Any source citation opens the same selected report and identifies the actual section.

survey_switch.facts: Resolve the explicit 2025 switch and answer from that report. Its first-wave total is 518 only if the served section supports it.
survey_switch.forbidden: Retaining the prior 2026 target or applying 2025 figures to 2026.
survey_switch.action: Exact permitted /file-detail citation for the newly selected report.
survey_switch.date: Summer is the study wave; the source identifies the publication month as November 2025.

body_unavailable.facts: Explain the missing/incomplete body or incompatible index using the seeded state. A catalog card may identify a report if the caller can read its metadata.
body_unavailable.forbidden: An answer presented as a body finding, quote or body citation without readable source evidence.
body_unavailable.action: Only a verified catalog link is allowed when body evidence is unavailable.

body_version.facts: Serve the permitted earlier Ready version with its stale label for soft stale; for hard stale, cite the current Standard fallback in the same KB.
body_version.forbidden: Calling an earlier version current, using hard-stale Ready content, or crossing KB membership.
body_version.action: Exact /file-detail citation with the served source version.
body_version.date: Serving version and publication date are distinct.

scope_denied.facts: Return permission or unavailable handling appropriate to the seeded caller and scope.
scope_denied.forbidden: Restricted answer text, evidence IDs, citation/card, selected target or unauthorized action.

staff_read.facts: Read the fixture-only body marker from its exact permitted staff KB and prove it with that file citation.
staff_read.forbidden: Showing an unlisted or unrelated document, or answering based on a staff file title alone.
staff_read.action: Exact authorized /file-detail link for the staff control.

quota_exceeded.facts: QUOTA_EXCEEDED with UTC reset guidance and zero physical generation/embedding calls.
quota_exceeded.forbidden: Calling the provider, consuming a new allowance, or giving a fabricated answer.
quota_exceeded.action: Existing guide and manual feedback remain available when enabled.

provider_failure.facts: Seeded transport failure maps to the actual safe error with bounded physical attempts and honest absence of an answer.
provider_failure.forbidden: A fabricated report answer, raw provider error/credential disclosure, or automatic user retry.
provider_failure.action: Existing guide and manual feedback remain available when enabled.

feedback_draft.facts: The editable draft preserves the exact input. Cancel and ordinary turns create zero feedback rows. Explicit submit writes only the edited text and returns one server receipt.
feedback_draft.forbidden: Assistant submitting autonomously or claiming a successful write before server receipt.
feedback_draft.action: Existing editable form with a separate user-confirmed submit.
